auth.signInSub: Welcome back. Sign in to manage your store.

notice.signedOut: You’re signed out of every store on this device.
notice.expired: You were signed out after a while without activity. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
notice.noStores: This account doesn’t belong to a store here. Ask the store’s owner to invite you.

auth.twoStepApp: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.resendWait: Didn’t get it? You can ask again in {seconds}s.
auth.codeLength: The code has 6 digits — check it again.
auth.backupSub: One of the 10 codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in, like K4P2-9XQM. Each works once.
auth.backupInvalid: That doesn’t look like a backup code — it’s 8 letters and numbers, like K4P2-9XQM.
auth.enrolPhoneSub: Store owners need it before the store opens — it protects your payouts and your customers’ data. We’ll text you a code each time you sign in.
auth.enrolCodeSub: Type the 6-digit code we texted to {hint}.
auth.codesSub: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. We won’t show them again.
auth.forgotSub: Type the email you sign in with. We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotEmailInvalid: Type the email address you sign in with.
auth.forgotSentSub: If {email} has an account, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes. Open it in your browser, choose a new password, then sign in here.
auth.lockedSub: There were 5 wrong passwords or codes in a row, so we paused sign-in for {minutes} minutes to keep your store safe. We’ve emailed the account owner. Reset your password to get back in now.
auth.chooseSub: Signed in as {email}. You belong to {count} stores — pick one to open.
auth.chooseRemoved: You no longer have access to {store} — its owner removed you. Your other stores still work.
auth.signOutBody: Signs you out of every store on this device.

profile.title: My profile
profile.sub: One account for every store you belong to. Changes here apply everywhere you sign in.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHelpChanged: We’ll send a link to the new address. It changes once you click it.
profile.emailSent: We sent a link to {email} — your email changes once you click it.
profile.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
profile.passwordNote: Changing it signs you out on every other device.
profile.passwordShort: The new password needs at least 10 characters.
profile.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords don’t match.
profile.passwordDone: Password changed — you’re signed out everywhere else.
profile.twoStepWhyOwner: Required for store owners — it protects your payouts and customer data. You can change how you get codes, but not turn it off.
profile.twoStepWhyOther: Optional for your role, and strongly recommended. Each sign-in asks for a code as well as your password.
profile.methodAppSub: Codes come from the app on your phone. Works without signal.
profile.methodSmsSub: Codes are texted to your mobile number.
profile.backupSoon: {count} of 10 backup codes left — make new ones soon
profile.newCodesBody: Your old codes stop working straight away.
profile.turnOffBody: Anyone with your password could then sign in as you.
profile.pickTitle: How do you want to get your codes?
profile.pickSmsSub: To the mobile number in Your details
profile.pickSmsNone: Add a mobile number in Your details first
profile.verifyAppTitle: Add this account to your authenticator app, then type the code it shows
profile.setupKey: Setup key — type it into Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or similar
profile.codesSub: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. We won’t show them again.
profile.signOutOthersBody: Every other device is signed out. This one stays signed in.

provisioning.title: Your store is being built —
provisioning.body: about a minute. Products work now; Storefront and Settings open when it’s ready.

pastDue.title: Your store is view-only.
pastDue.body: Your last payment didn’t go through. Everything is safe — pay in the web portal to start editing again.

trial.title: Free trial · {days}.
trial.body: You have everything while it lasts. No card needed.

trialEnding.title: Your trial ends tomorrow.
trialEnding.body: Choose a plan in the web portal to keep everything, or pick what to keep on the free plan.

trialEnded.title: Your trial ended — you’re on the free plan.
trialEnded.body: Items over the free plan’s limits are paused, never deleted.

bandwidth.title: You’ve used {percent}% of this month’s bandwidth.

whiteLabel.title: White-label is on.
whiteLabel.body: Your customers see your own name everywhere — not DripFunnel.

suspended.title: This store is suspended.
suspended.body: Nothing can be changed and the shop shows a notice. {contact}
suspended.noContact: Contact your store’s provider to find out why.

cancelled.title: This store is cancelled.
cancelled.body: You can look around and export until the paid period ends.

collections.title: Collections
collections.sub: Groups of products shown together on your store, like “Summer Sale” or “Men’s Shirts”.
collections.viewOnly: You can look at collections but not change them.

empty.title: Group your products
empty.body: Collections become the pages and menu links of your shop — “Summer Sale”, “Gifts under {price}”, “Men’s Shirts”. Pick products by hand, or let them fill themselves.
empty.bodyNoPrice: Collections become the pages and menu links of your shop — “Summer Sale”, “Gifts”, “Men’s Shirts”. Pick products by hand, or let them fill themselves.

editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: Shown at the top of the collection page
editor.automaticSub: Every product matching your rules — new ones join by themselves

kept.one: 1 more rule this screen doesn’t change is kept as it is.

deleteBody.other: The {count} products stay in your catalogue — only the group goes.

filters.title: Filters
filters.sub: The checkboxes shoppers see on the left of your shop.
filters.viewOnly: You can look at filters but not change them.
filters.none: No filters yet. Create one — Fabric, Occasion or Fit — and add its values.

filters.makeShopper: {name}: only you see these. Show it to shoppers

uses.other: {count} products use it. Renaming keeps them all; deleting takes it off them.

deleteBody.other: {count} products lose it, and automatic collections using it will shrink.

filters.tags: only you see them, like “Reorder soon”.

noResults.body: Check the spelling, or clear your search and filters.

empty.title: Add your first product

review.title: Review · from {supplier}

free.title: Selling for free?

details.title: Details

visibility.visibleSub: Shoppers can find and buy it
visibility.hiddenSub: Only you and your team can see it

choices.title: Choices
choices.kindName: Name of this kind of choice
choices.valuePlaceholder: Type a choice, or several with commas
choices.upToThree: Up to 3 kinds of choice per product

needTitle.one: Your 1 version needs a {name}. Which is it?
needTitle.other: Your {count} versions need a {name}. Which is it?

choices.needBody: Tell us what the versions you already have are. You can add the other choices after.
choices.addedUpdate: Added {name}. Press “Update versions” to create its versions.
choices.addChoicesFirst: Add at least one choice to each kind.

newOnes.one: 1 new version to create — pre-filled from the first one.
newOnes.other: {count} new versions to create — pre-filled from the first one.

ready.one: 1 version ready — set its price below
ready.other: {count} versions ready — set prices and counts below

versions.title: Versions · {count}
versions.setPriceTitle: Set the price of every version
versions.setGroupTitle: Set the price of every {group} version
versions.notMade: We don’t make this · Add back

stock.title: Stock
stock.help: How many you have ready to sell. We count down as orders come in.
stock.untracked: Not tracked for this kind of product.
stock.noWarehouse: There is no location to count stock in yet. Add one on the web.
stock.label: Stock of {name} at {warehouse}

reserved.one: {count} reserved for orders · sold, not shipped yet.
reserved.other: {count} reserved for orders · sold, not shipped yet.

stock.adjustBody: {name}: shown in the stock history, so everyone knows why the number moved. It is saved right away, apart from the rest of the product.
stock.adjustCount: How many? Use − to remove, e.g. −2
stock.historyNote: Every change is kept — by hand, by orders, by suppliers and by imports.
stock.failed: The product saved, but the counts didn’t. Try saving again.
stock.newFailed: The product saved, but its counts didn’t. Open it and count the stock again.

aplus.title: A+ content · Product story
aplus.summary: Big photos and feature blocks below your product
aplus.plan: A+ content isn’t on your plan.
aplus.saveFirst: Save the product first, then add its A+ content.
aplus.saveChangesFirst: Save your changes first, then open its A+ content.

ready.title: Ready to sell in
ready.afterSave: Shown once the product is saved.
ready.note: Missing details only stop sales in that country.
ready.onWeb: Details like fibre content and care are added on the web for now.

refused.VERSION_CHOICES: Press “Update versions” so every version has one value for each kind of choice.

story.title: Headline

state.changed: Draft has changes · live page unchanged
state.draft: Draft · not on your store yet

story.videoOff: Video is switched off in Settings › Catalogue
story.templateBody: Your current modules will be swapped out. Nothing is published until you publish.
story.templateAdded: {name} template added — fill in each module

story.empty: Add a module, or start from a template. Shoppers see this below your product description.
story.tooMany: {max} modules is the most a product can have — remove one to add another

story.compareNote: Rows come from each product’s Specifications — never retyped.

story.brandSupplier: Brand stories are your store owner’s.
story.brandFailed: We couldn’t load your brand stories. Try again in a moment.
story.fromProduct: Shows this product’s {what}, as they are in the editor.

gaps.one: 1 thing to fill in before publishing — it’s marked.
gaps.other: {count} things to fill in before publishing — they’re marked.

story.saved: Draft saved — your live page hasn’t changed
story.published: A+ content is live on your product page
story.submitted: Sent for approval with the product

sizeChart.title: Size chart
sizeChart.hint: Shoppers return fewer orders when there’s a size chart.
sizeChart.failed: Size charts didn’t load, so the chart can’t be changed here. Reload to try again.

payments.gatewaysSub: How your shoppers pay you. The card that pays for your plan isn’t here.
payments.gatewaysNote: With more than one live, shoppers pick at checkout. Suggested for {country}.
payments.gatewaysNoteBare: With more than one live, shoppers pick at checkout.
payments.otherSub: Orders paid this way stay “Payment pending” until you mark them paid.
payments.emptyTitle: No ways to get paid here yet
payments.emptyBody: Payment providers are offered to stores in India and the United States. Your store’s country is set when it’s created.

desc.stripe: Cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
desc.phonepe: UPI-first, with its own app handoff.
desc.cod: Your courier collects. Unpaid until the cash reaches you.
desc.bank_transfer: Your account details at checkout. Unpaid until you mark it paid.

payments.notOffered: Connecting {name} isn’t set up on this platform yet. Ask your platform’s support.
payments.testOnly: Test keys only: your preview storefront takes test payments; your live storefront doesn’t offer it yet.
payments.stripeBody: Stripe connects on the web portal. It opens in your phone’s browser: sign in there if it asks, tap Connect on Stripe’s row, and approve on Stripe’s page. Back in this app, Payment setup shows the result.
payments.stripeOpened: Opened the web portal in your browser
payments.keysBody: Paste the keys from your {name} dashboard. The secrets are saved and never shown again. Shoppers can pay with it as soon as it connects.
payments.connectedLive: {name} connected — shoppers can pay with it now
payments.connectedTest: {name} test keys saved — your preview storefront takes test payments
payments.codBody: Your courier collects the money. Orders stay “Payment pending” until you mark them paid. Shoppers see it at checkout from now on.
payments.bankBody: Shoppers see these details at checkout and in their order confirmation, from now on.
payments.bankPlaceholder: Account name, routing number, account number
payments.bankMissing: Type the details shoppers pay to.
payments.offBody: Shoppers stop seeing it at checkout. Orders already paid aren’t affected.
payments.disconnectBody: Shoppers stop seeing it at checkout, and its keys are removed. Orders already paid aren’t affected.

shipping.chargeTitle: What the shopper pays for delivery
shipping.chargeSub: Turn on one or more: shoppers pick at checkout.
shipping.courierRateBy: Quoted at checkout by {name}, from address and weight.
shipping.flatFallback: Charged only when no courier can quote an order.
shipping.pickupOff: Your address and hours show at checkout instead.
shipping.hoursBody: Shown at checkout and in the order confirmation.
shipping.freeOver: Orders of {amount} or more ship free.
shipping.partnersSub: They quote rates, book pickups and send tracking.
shipping.partnersNone: No delivery partners are offered for your store’s country yet.

shipping.descFailed: Its login was rejected at the last test. Orders fall back to the next partner.
shipping.descNotOffered: This courier isn’t set up on your platform yet. Ask your platform’s support to connect it.

shipping.usePricingBody: {name} will quote every order at checkout from now on, and the one that does now goes to standby.
shipping.nowPricing: {name} prices orders now — the one before is on standby

pickupChoices.on_request: You book each one from the order

trackingChoices.on: On: sent when the courier scans the parcel

shipping.disconnectLast: No courier is left to quote, so checkout stops offering the courier’s rate.

shipping.testNone: Connect a courier first: there is nothing to test.

testResults.ok: {name} — quoted a test parcel to your own address in {seconds} s
testResults.rejected: {name} — login rejected. Ask your platform’s support to check its account.
testResults.unavailable: {name} — didn’t answer. Try again in a minute.

shipping.everywhereSub: In the countries set up in Markets.
shipping.listSub: A shopper outside your area is told at the address step, not at payment.

shipping.noCodes: We couldn’t find any {label}s in what you pasted.
shipping.tooMany: That has more than {max} codes. Keep it to {max}.
shipping.areaReadSave: {count} {label}s kept. Save shipping to deliver only there.
shipping.saveNote: Saving changes what shoppers pay for delivery at checkout, from now on.

both.label: Both

people.emailInvalid: That doesn’t look like an email address

people.roleTakesTime: Role changes can take a few minutes to apply.
people.roleChanged: {name} is now {role} — it can take a few minutes to apply

suppliers.title: Your suppliers

sub.one: 1 company, {products} of your products. Their products sell under your store’s name.
sub.other: {count} companies, {products} of your products. Their products sell under your store’s name.

suppliers.emailInvalid: That doesn’t look like an email address

access.vendor-orders-read: Products, stock and seeing their orders

accessSubs.vendor-catalogue: They add and edit their own products. The usual choice.
accessSubs.vendor-orders-read: They also see the orders with their items.
accessSubs.vendor-orders-fulfil: They also see and pack the orders with their items.

suppliers.approvalOffSub: Off — supplier products go live when they save them.

suppliers.none: No suppliers yet. Invite a company whose products you want to sell under your name.

suppliers.accessChanged: {name}: {access} — takes a few minutes to apply
suppliers.shippingBody: Who sends their items, and on whose account the labels are bought.
suppliers.toStore: To you, and you ship them on

suspendBody.one: They can’t sign in to your store. Their 1 product is still in your catalogue.
suspendBody.other: They can’t sign in to your store. Their {count} products are still in your catalogue.

warehouse.editBody: Labels and pick lists use the new details from now on.
warehouse.name: Name
warehouse.makeDefaultBody: New products start here. Existing stock doesn’t move.

warehouse.madeDefault: {name} is now the default — existing stock doesn’t move
warehouse.saved: Saved — labels and pick lists use the new details

warehouse.empty: No locations yet. Add the first one, where your stock sits.

sectionHelp.video: Upload or link a YouTube video

catalogue.saveBody: Turning a section off hides it on every product. What you’ve written is kept. Turning one on shows it on every product.
catalogue.sectionsSaved: Sections saved — products now show what you switched on
catalogue.badgesSub: Small labels on product photos. Automatic ones come and go by themselves; manual ones you add on each product.
catalogue.noBadges: No badges yet. Add one, then pick it on a product or let it apply by itself.
catalogue.badgeBody: Up to 18 characters. When it shows is the second choice below.

rules.new_30_days: Added in the last 30 days — automatic
rules.top_5_this_month: Your 5 best sellers this month — automatic
rules.below_compare_price: Has a lower price than its compare price — automatic
rules.manual: You choose the products — pick it on each product

ruleShort.below_compare_price: Has a lower price than its compare price

catalogue.ruleOther: Shown by a rule set elsewhere
catalogue.badgeAddedManual: “{name}” added — pick it on any product under Badges
catalogue.deleteBadgeBody: It comes off every product straight away.

states.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your data is safe — we’re still loading it.

loadErr.title: We couldn’t load {name}
loadErr.body: Nothing is lost — this is a problem on our side, not your data. It usually clears in a few seconds.
loadErr.ref: Ref 503 · {ref} — quote this if you contact support

notFound.label: this page
notFound.title: This page isn’t here any more
notFound.body: The link may be old, or what it pointed to was deleted or moved. Nothing else in your store has changed.

denied.title: You don’t have access to {name}
denied.body: Your role can’t open {name}. Ask the store’s owner if you need it.
denied.bodySupplier: Your supplier access can’t open {name}. Ask {store} if you need it.

offline.body: Check your connection. What you’ve already opened stays here — changes need a connection.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.note: Development builds only. Picks what the shell draws so each state can be checked without a store in it.

search.label: Search orders
search.placeholder: Search by order number or name

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Your first order will appear here. Share your store link to get it.

export.title: Orders export
export.truncated: Only the first {count} lines are in it; narrow the filter to see the rest.
export.expired: That export has expired. Export again.
export.tooLarge: That export is too large. Narrow the filter and try again.
export.failed: The export couldn’t be made. Try again.
export.shareFailed: The file couldn’t be shared. Try again.

detail.test: Test order from a preview · never ships
detail.readOnly: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid. You can look, but orders can’t be changed until then.

ship.noLocation: Add a location under Settings › Warehouse before you ship.
ship.loadFailed: Your locations couldn’t be loaded. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.
ship.bookSub: We buy the label at {courier}’s cheapest service and fill in the tracking number. It covers one seller’s items.
ship.ownSub: Use your own courier, or the one you booked elsewhere.
ship.trackingHint: Without one, the shopper’s email says “on its way” with no link.
ship.linkInvalid: A tracking link starts with https://
ship.linkNeedsNumber: Add the tracking number this link is for.
ship.pickNone: Pick at least one item to ship.
ship.note: Shipping part of an order is normal — the rest stays “to ship”. The shopper gets an email, with tracking if you add it.
ship.noteBook: Booking buys the label now, and the shopper is told it’s on its way. A booked parcel can’t be undone here.
ship.notePickup: The shopper collects this order. Mark it handed over once they have it.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.addBody: The shopper gets the tracking number by email.
shipments.added: Tracking saved — the shopper gets it by email
shipments.requestPickup: Ask the courier to collect it
shipments.pickupRequested: Pickup requested — the courier collects it

markPaid.title: Mark {number} as paid?
markPaid.body: Only once the {amount} has actually reached you ({method}).
markPaid.bodyNoAmount: Only once the money has actually reached you ({method}).

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing has happened to this order yet.

returns.title: Return {number}
returns.cancelBody: Use this when the shopper keeps the items. Nothing is refunded, and the items can be returned again later.

start.title: Start a return
start.note: The items come back to their owner’s location.
start.noteSuppliers: The items come back to their owner’s location. Suppliers refund their own items once you mark them received.
start.pickNone: Pick at least one item coming back.
start.done: Return started — mark it received when the items are back
start.doneSuppliers: Return started — {suppliers} will refund their items once they’re back

refund.title: Refund
refund.override: {supplier} normally refunds their own items. Refunding here overrides them: it’s recorded against {supplier}, for you to settle with them.
refund.amountPicked: What they paid for the picked items
refund.restock: Put the picked items back in stock
refund.note: Money goes back through {method}. Pick items, or type an amount for a goodwill refund.
refund.noteByHand: You give the money back yourself ({method}); this records that you did. Pick items, or type an amount for a goodwill refund.
refund.pickNone: Pick items, or type an amount.
refund.doneOverride: Refunded to {name} — recorded against {suppliers} to settle with them

cancel.title: Cancel {number}?
cancel.bodyPaid: {name} gets back what they paid, through {method}. The items go back in stock.
cancel.bodyUnpaid: Nothing has been paid, so nothing is refunded. The items go back in stock.

order.oversold: Sold more than was in stock

payment.amount_mismatch: Paid a different amount than the order

customers.title: Customers
customers.lede: Everyone who has bought from you, or that you added.
customers.readOnly: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid. You can look, but customers can’t be changed until then.

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.body: Your customers appear here after their first order. You can also add one yourself.

search.label: Search customers
search.placeholder: Search by name, email or tag

export.truncated: Only the first {count} rows are in it; narrow the search to see the rest.
export.expired: That export has expired. Export again.
export.tooLarge: That export is too large. Narrow the search and try again.
export.failed: The export couldn’t be made. Try again.
export.shareFailed: The file couldn’t be shared. Try again.

detail.noGroups: No groups yet — make one on the Groups tab.
detail.addedTo: {name} added to {group} — offers for this group apply to them now
detail.tagsFull: A customer can have up to 20 tags.

tag.title: Add a tag
tag.body: Tags help you find people, like Repeat, Press or Local.
tag.label: Tag

consent.title: Marketing consent
consent.optedInSms: Yes to marketing emails and texts
consent.declined: No marketing — they didn’t tick the box
consent.since: Since {date} · {where}. Only the shopper can opt in — from checkout or their email.
consent.stoppedOn: Recorded {date}. Order and delivery emails still go to them.
consent.byHand: Added by hand, so they get order emails only. They can opt in from any email you send.
consent.notAskedSub: They get order and delivery emails only. Only the shopper can opt in.
consent.stop: Record that they asked to stop
consent.stopBody: Do this when they ask you directly. They still get order and delivery emails.

editForm.title: Edit {name}
editForm.body: Past orders keep the details they were placed with.
editForm.name: Full name
editForm.addressPartial: Fill in the street, city and country, or leave the address empty.
editForm.saved: Saved — past orders keep the details they were placed with

addForm.title: Add a customer
addForm.body: For people who buy in person or by phone. They don’t get an email from adding them.
addForm.name: Full name
addForm.emailInvalid: That doesn’t look like an email address.
addForm.existed: {name} is already a customer — opened them

groups.intro: Groups let you give an offer to some customers only — for example VIP or Wholesale. Add people to a group from their customer page.
groups.body: Offers can be given to a group only.
groups.made: {name} made — add people from their customer page

deleteBody.one: {count} person leaves the group. Offers for {name} stop applying to them.
deleteBody.other: {count} people leave the group. Offers for {name} stop applying to them.

groups.deleteEmpty: Nobody is in this group. Offers for {name} stop applying to it.

imports.title: Import & export
imports.lede: Bring products in from a spreadsheet or Shopify. Nothing changes in your catalogue until you confirm.
imports.readOnly: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid, so nothing can be imported. Exports still work.

file.title: Import from a spreadsheet
file.body: A CSV file, or Shopify’s product export. Our template has one example row.

shopify.title: Bring products from Shopify
shopify.body: Connect your Shopify store and pick what to bring over — photos, choices and all.

template.title: Download the template
template.body: Every column we read, with one example row: name, price, stock, product code, photos and the rest.

type.title: That file type can’t be imported
type.body: {name} isn’t a CSV file. Save it as CSV (in Excel: File › Save a copy › CSV) and choose it again.

big.title: That file is too big
big.body: {name} is {size}; the limit is 5 MB. Split it into two files, or import from Shopify instead.

empty.title: That file has no products in it
empty.body: {name} has a header row but nothing under it. Add at least one product, one per row.

cols.title: Some columns we need are missing
cols.body: {name} has no “name” or “handle” column. Share the current template, or rename your columns to match it.

unreadable.title: That file couldn’t be read
unreadable.body: {name} didn’t open. Choose it again, or save a copy as CSV first.

shopify.title: Connect your Shopify store
shopify.note: We’ll open Shopify in your browser so you can approve read-only access. The browser then lands on your portal, which may ask you to sign in. Come back to the app when it says Shopify is connected.
shopify.waiting: Waiting for Shopify. Approve in the browser, then come back here.
shopify.notYet: Shopify isn’t connected yet. Finish in the browser, then check again.
shopify.expired: Shopify stopped letting us in — the connection expired. Connect again to carry on.
shopify.unavailable: Connecting Shopify isn’t set up here. Import Shopify’s product CSV instead, with “Import from a spreadsheet”.
shopify.away: Shopify isn’t answering right now. Try again in a minute.

pick.title: Connected to {shop} · pick products
pick.allChosen: Every product in your shop is chosen.
pick.max: You can pick up to 250. To bring more, choose “Select all”.
pick.loadAll: Every product in your shop is chosen. To leave some out, show every page first, or clear all and tick the ones you want.
pick.moreFailed: Those products didn’t load. What you’ve ticked is kept; try again.
pick.failedBody: Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

check.readyNote: {new} new · {matched} you already have (matched by product code)
check.problemsBody: Fix them in your file and choose it again, or import the ready ones now.
check.skip: Skip them, only add new ones

running.progress: {done} of {total} done. You can leave this screen — the import carries on, and you’ll find it here again.
running.pausedBody: Nothing is half-saved: the products done so far are in, and the rest carry on when you reconnect.
running.leave: Go to Products while it runs

stopped.title: The import stopped
stopped.body: Nothing more was changed. Try again, or import a file instead.

export.title: Export
export.lede: Your files are made in the background. When one is ready, share it or save it to your phone.
export.preparing: Preparing your file… big exports run in the background.
export.truncated: Only the first {count} rows are in it.
export.shareFailed: The file couldn’t be shared. Try again.
export.failedNote: The export couldn’t be made. Try again.
